|`SUBI` |32 |- |`subi SrcL, uimm, ->{t, u, Rd}` |SUBI subtracts the zero-extended unsigned 12-bit immediate from the snapshotted XLEN source modulo 2^PTO_XLEN and publishes the result through RegDst.
|`SUBIW` |32 |- |`subiw SrcL, uimm, ->{t, u, Rd}` |SUBIW subtracts the zero-extended unsigned 12-bit immediate from SrcL[31:0] modulo 2^32, sign-extends the word result to XLEN, and publishes it through RegDst.
|`SUBW` |32 |- |`subw SrcL, SrcR<{.sw,.uw,.neg}><<<shamt>, ->{t, u, Rd}` |SUBW applies the selected right-source transformation before its encoded logical left shift, performs fixed-width word subtraction, and publishes the low 32-bit result sign-extended to XLEN.
|`XOR` |32 |- |`xor SrcL, SrcR<{.sw,.uw,.not}><<<shamt>, ->{t, u, Rd}` |XOR applies the selected right-source transformation before its encoded logical left shift, performs bitwise exclusive OR, and publishes the PTO_XLEN result.
|`XORI` |32 |- |`xori SrcL, simm, ->{t, u, Rd}` |XORI sign-extends simm12 to PTO_XLEN, XORs it with the snapshotted XLEN source, and publishes the complete result through RegDst.
|`XORIW` |32 |- |`xoriw SrcL, simm, ->{t, u, Rd}` |XORIW XORs SrcL[31:0] with the low 32 bits of sign-extended simm12, sign-extends the result to XLEN, and publishes it through RegDst.
|`XORW` |32 |- |`xorw SrcL, SrcR<{.sw,.uw,.not}><<<shamt>, ->{t, u, Rd}` |XORW applies the selected right-source transformation before its encoded logical left shift, performs word bitwise exclusive OR, and publishes the low 32-bit result sign-extended to XLEN.
|===

|`ESAVE` |32 |- |`ESAVE [RegSrc0=BasePtr, RegSrc1=LenBytes, RegSrc2=Kind]` |Inventories an extension-owned execution-context save family rejected by PTO before operand interpretation or effects.

|`FABS` |32 |- |`fabs.{T} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FABS clears the sign bit of the selected FP64 or FP32 carrier, preserves every other carrier bit, and publishes no numeric flags.
|`FADD` |32 |- |`fadd.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FADD adds two selected FP64 or FP32 carriers through the active numeric profile and publishes its sticky flags.
|`FCVT` |32 |- |`fcvt.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FCVT converts an FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 source to any of those four floating destinations through the common scalar/TCVT profile.
|`FCVTA` |32 |- |`fcvta.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FCVTA converts an FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 source to U64/U32/U16/U8 or S64/S32/S16/S8 with fixed round-away mode.
|`FCVTM` |32 |- |`fcvtm.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FCVTM converts an FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 source to U64/U32/U16/U8 or S64/S32/S16/S8 with fixed round-down mode.
|`FCVTN` |32 |- |`fcvtn.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FCVTN converts an FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 source to U64/U32/U16/U8 or S64/S32/S16/S8 with fixed round-nearest mode.
|`FCVTP` |32 |- |`fcvtp.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FCVTP converts an FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 source to U64/U32/U16/U8 or S64/S32/S16/S8 with fixed round-up mode.
|`FCVTZ` |32 |- |`fcvtz.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FCVTZ converts an FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 source to U64/U32/U16/U8 or S64/S32/S16/S8 with fixed round-toward-zero mode.
|`FDIV` |32 |- |`fdiv.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FDIV divides the left selected carrier by the right through the active numeric profile and publishes its sticky flags.
|`FEQ` |32 |- |`feq.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FEQ performs ordered quiet equality and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FEQS` |32 |- |`feqs.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FEQS performs ordered signaling equality and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FEXP` |32 |- |`fexp.{T} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FEXP applies the active numeric profile exponential operation to the selected FP64 or FP32 carrier.
|`FGE` |32 |- |`fge.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FGE performs ordered quiet greater-than-or-equal comparison and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FGES` |32 |- |`fges.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FGES performs ordered signaling greater-than-or-equal comparison and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FLT` |32 |- |`flt.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FLT performs ordered quiet less-than comparison and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FLTS` |32 |- |`flts.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FLTS performs ordered signaling less-than comparison and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FMADD` |32 |- |`fmadd.{T} SrcL, SrcR, SrcA, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FMADD computes one fused SrcL multiplied by SrcR plus SrcA operation through the active numeric profile.
|`FMAX` |32 |- |`fmax.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FMAX applies the architecture-owned ordered maximum, NaN, and signed-zero rules to selected FP64 or FP32 carriers.
|`FMIN` |32 |- |`fmin.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FMIN applies the architecture-owned ordered minimum, NaN, and signed-zero rules to selected FP64 or FP32 carriers.
|`FMSUB` |32 |- |`fmsub.{T} SrcL, SrcR, SrcA, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FMSUB computes one fused SrcL multiplied by SrcR minus SrcA operation through the active numeric profile.
|`FMUL` |32 |- |`fmul.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FMUL multiplies two selected FP64 or FP32 carriers through the active numeric profile and publishes its sticky flags.
|`FNE` |32 |- |`fne.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FNE performs ordered quiet inequality and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FNES` |32 |- |`fnes.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FNES performs ordered signaling inequality and returns canonical XLEN zero or one.
|`FNMADD` |32 |- |`fnmadd.{T} SrcL, SrcR, SrcA, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FNMADD computes the negation of one fused SrcL multiplied by SrcR plus SrcA operation through the active numeric profile.
|`FNMSUB` |32 |- |`fnmsub.{T} SrcL, SrcR, SrcA, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FNMSUB computes the negation of one fused SrcL multiplied by SrcR minus SrcA operation through the active numeric profile.
|`FRECIP` |32 |- |`frecip.{T} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FRECIP applies the active numeric profile reciprocal operation to the selected FP64 or FP32 carrier.
|`FSQRT` |32 |- |`fsqrt.{T} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FSQRT applies the active numeric profile square-root operation to the selected FP64 or FP32 carrier.
|`FSUB` |32 |- |`fsub.{T} SrcL, SrcR, ->{t, u, Rd}` |FSUB subtracts the right selected carrier from the left through the active numeric profile and publishes its sticky flags.
|`SCVTF` |32 |- |`scvtf.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |SCVTF converts an S64, S32, S16, or S8 source to FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 through the common scalar/TCVT profile.
|`UCVTF` |32 |- |`ucvtf.{srcT2dstT} SrcL, ->{t, u, Rd}` |UCVTF converts a U64, U32, U16, or U8 source to FP64, FP32, FP16, or E4M3 through the common scalar/TCVT profile.
|===
